hero.heading: Bermuda Blend — *Natural Desert-Ready Tones*
hero.body: Designed to replicate the earthy, natural look of real Bermuda grass with an Olive & Green "Chant" tone. A lower-profile option that blends seamlessly into Arizona's desert landscape.

intro.label: About the Series
intro.heading: Earthy, Natural, Desert-Native Look
body: The **Bermuda Blend Series** is designed to replicate the earthy, natural look of real Bermuda grass with an **Olive & Green "Chant"** tone. A natural-looking, lower-profile option that blends seamlessly into desert landscaping and Southwest-style hardscape.

Bermuda Blend 70 is our most affordable turf — perfect for accents, front yards, and budget-conscious low-traffic installations. Bermuda Blend 93 steps up density and pile height for fuller residential coverage that still keeps that classic Bermuda look.
Want to see the color in person? [Stop by our showroom](/contact) for a free sample.

items.heading: Chant Olive & Green
